Limit  (cost=6.21..6.21 rows=1 width=1236)
  ->  Sort  (cost=6.21..6.21 rows=1 width=1236)
        Sort Key: path COLLATE "C"
        ->  Index Scan using ix_vfs_entries_index_pending on vfs_entries  (cost=0.41..6.20 rows=1 width=1236)
              Index Cond: ((encoded = false) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
              Filter: (((path)::text <> '/'::text) AND ((path)::text <> '/.vfs'::text) AND ((path)::text !~~ '/.vfs/%'::text) AND ((kind)::text = ANY ('{chunk,file,version}'::text[])))
